name: Waking Nightmare
flavor: You don't show them anything real. You just remind their nerves what pain used to feel like, and let the memory do the rest.
description: You reach into a creature's mind within range and make it briefly, completely certain that it is being torn apart. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw against your {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}, taking [[3d8]] psychic damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. A creature immune to being frightened has advantage on this saving throw, since the illusion has nothing to take hold of. Casting this costs 3 Phantasm — it is the payoff you bank the meter for, not something you open with, and the Phantasm is spent whether or not the target's mind gives way.
narration: You do not show them anything real. You simply remind their nerves what being torn apart used to feel like, and let the body take it from there.
sheetSummary: Intelligence save vs {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}. Fail: [[3d8]] psychic damage. Success: half. Fear-immune creatures have advantage on the save.
